notes.title: Innerspace 10th Anniversary Bundle !!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38154301/4bcbee1da0183c43a2f6841452c69af4128c5c13.jpg[/img]

Discover A Fisherman's Tale, its sequel A Fisherman's Tale 2, and Maskmaker in a special celebration bundle. The full price of the three games is $49,97 and we offer the bundle for $19,99 (-60%).

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45276/Innerspace_10th_Anniversary/]Bundle page here![/url]

A Fisherman’s Tale
Bend and twist reality in A Fisherman's Tale, the mind-bending VR puzzle adventure game in which being turned upside down and inside out is not merely a play on words.
Playing as Bob, a tiny fisherman puppet, you live alone in your tiny cabin, oblivious to the world outside.

A Fisherman’s Tale 2
Embark on a new, mind-bending VR adventure A Fisherman's Tale 2. Immerse yourself in poetic storytelling as you explore new mind-bending VR puzzle mechanics. Discover the truth as you journey through beautiful and unique locations and solve puzzles using your own body.

Maskmaker
In a mysterious universe you play as a Maskmaker's apprentice and learn the magic of crafting masks to immerse yourself in the intriguing enigmatic beings within the game. From mask-to-mask and puzzle-to-puzzle, explore your way through the "mask realm" to seek Prospero who appears to rule it and ultimately unravel the secret of his identity.

During these 4 days, you will also be able to access Innerspace’s latest title One True Path for free on  Steam and Quest stores, a thrilling adventure mixing action and puzzles across fictional worlds featuring a wild mix of visual styles, genres and gameplay, AND Innerspace’s past experiences [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/436490/Firebird__La_Peri/]La Peri[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/691430/Firebird__The_Unfinished/]The Unfinished[/url] which will also be available for 0,99$!

notes.title: Early Access live for One True Path
notes.notes:
InnerspaceVR is proud to reveal [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3217200/One_True_Path/]One True Path[/url], a unique narrative-driven VR adventure. From the developers of the critically-acclaimed A Fisherman’s Tale, embark on a thrilling adventure mixing action, puzzle and mystery. Travel between fictional worlds with wildly different visual styles, genres and gameplay. Solve the mysterious murder of best-selling but embittered gamebook author Jack Stevenson by diving headfirst into the grim and fantastical worlds of his Fiendish Fates© series.

[previewyoutube=AZqlYZ_EdAU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]EXPERIENCE A WIDE VARIETY OF ACTION & PUZZLE GAMEPLAY[/h2]
Travel through 3 fantastical worlds from Jack’s Fiendish Fates book series, each featuring different themes and gameplay: Magical sword in hand, slash your way through the necromantic Army of Evil, led by the demonic Grey Knight. In Butchers of Orion, use your mind-powers and body-hopping abilities to escape the slaughterhouse spaceship of the life-sucking Lady Oriana and her drones. Blast the corrupt guards of Sheriff Cassidy’s wasteland penitentiary with your shock-hand and trusty cyber-shooter in Prisoner of the Cyberhounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38154301/631343c77610f2d8fc45a8bd15ec0e1e91b3b95b.png[/img]

[h2]UNVEIL THE MYSTERY OF THE AUTHOR’S DEATH[/h2]
Witness Jack Stevenson’s personal rise and fall, as you explore his final and most intimate work.
Discover clues, secrets and personal notes to decipher the story behind the books and the true meaning of your journey through Jack’s fictional worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38154301/d4e2fb90b545f0e81859cc0684d1c20c159bd0fd.png[/img]

[h2]PREPARE FOR A MIND-BENDING JOURNEY[/h2]
Jack’s final masterpiece couldn’t really be complete without one of his world-famous twists. But he never expected this twist: the death of the author! Discover Jack’s true killer by exploring the grim and fantastical worlds of his Fiendish Fates gamebook series! Escape his stories’ perils through cracks in between the worlds! Exploit interdimensional portals to cross between place, time, and gameplay styles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38154301/46ab502b1f2be7cef5dd747a6d4894bbe109e3b5.png[/img]

Are you ready, adventurer? Your journey starts [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3217200/One_True_Path/]here[/url]!

notes.title: Unleash your inner monkey: TOSS!🍌 is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=QcXWv2auBpQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]TOSS IS OUT NOW![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/

TOSS!🍌 has been with us for close to five years, and it's difficult to put into words just how excited we are to finally share it with all of you.

The sheer love and effort we've poured into making TOSS!🍌 is something we will remember as part of this amazing time, and the tons of feedback and encouragement we have gotten from you - the awesome players - is what has been pushing us.

We are super proud of what we've accomplished, and thrilled to continue our journey on TOSS!🍌 together with you!

[h3][b]WHAT TO EXPECT[/b][/h3]

Swing and toss yourself freely across spacey jungle-gym playgrounds, as an acrobatic monkey, in this bananas VR platformer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/63b9cc960ff7d4201aa1299f0c7b997d02b9f3da.png[/img]

You've crash landed on a cloud planet and will need to collect parts to repair your ship as you launch yourself around 75+ playground levels in 9 vibrant cloudscape biomes and rank-up to become a TOSS!🍌 master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/9a8747638a93f76034cfd6c21c764b6d4f05a0bd.png[/img]

This VR game uniquely captures the agility, timing and gamer skill required to play the beloved platformer classics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/dec52a3ce7cbe9fba8a579781126c12cf7c43146.png[/img]


🐵 [b]PARKOUR ACTION:[/b] Soar and launch yourselves through the air, grab hold of trees, pipes, and walls.

🔥 [b]CHALLENGES:[/b] Try to race against the clock, with Time Attack; find as many bananas as possible or master as few grabs as possible in each round.

🍌 [b]SOCIAL COMPETITION:[/b] Compete against each other by time and rank, and follow your friends' leaderboard ghosts.

🥋 [b]MASTERY & MODIFIERS:[/b] Unlock modifiers like Zero Gravity and Double Toss by becoming a TOSS!🍌 master!

[h3][b]GRAB IT NOW[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/

-- Albin, Simon, Eddie & Toss

notes.title: New from Innerspace VR: Another Fisherman's Tale OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
The sequel to the VR Game of the Year 2019, Another Fisherman's Tale tells another magical, moving story about the meaning we can give to our lives, through building and rebuilding our own selves.

[previewyoutube=MIh37NPmJXw;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096570/Another_Fishermans_Tale/

[h2]Several hours next-gen VR poetic storytelling[/h2]

The stories of two characters divided by time collide, as you search for the truth about Bob's past. Through Nina's eyes, you'll re-enact his adventures and unravel the mysteries of his past and expeditions, the pirates, sunken ships, treasures, and mystical locations.

[h2]A set of all-new mind-bending core VR mechanics[/h2]

This time, your own body is the key to the puzzle; creating unconventional gameplay based on dismantling and reconstructing your own self.

[h2]A unique setting for a whimsical VR[/h2]

While Nina is cleaning up the basement of her mother's house, she discovers another old model from her father, Bob the Fisherman. And so, the adventure continues...

notes.title: Beyond the Mask 'The Making of Maskmaker'
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,
Welcome to part two of Beyond the Mask, The Making of Maskmaker. Follow along with Balthazar as he shares more of the story behind the fantastical Maskmaker's apprentice and the process of making masks in VR.

[previewyoutube=aiqWy31TUfk;full][/previewyoutube]
Don the mask. Explore new worlds. In this all-new behind-the-scenes featurette, creator Balthazar Auxietre of InnerspaceVR leads us through the mysterious, mystical fantasy world of the game, and how the player will interact with it to become the Maskmaker. 

We are excited to see what you will discover in the magical world of Maskmaker, and how you will use it to craft spellbinding masks. Your adventure begins when the game releases on April 20th.

Sincerely,
The MWM Interactive Team

notes.title: Beyond the Mask 'The Making of Maskmaker'
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,
We could not be more excited to share Maskmaker with you when it releases on April 20th. In the meantime, be sure to check out part one of Beyond the Mask, The Making of Maskmaker.

[previewyoutube=AkHgJYeC0C0;full][/previewyoutube]
Go behind the scenes of Maskmaker with creator Balthazar Auxietre, starting with a look at the technology of Maskmaker. Learn about the history of Innerspace VR, the team behind the game, and the beginnings of what would someday become MASKMAKER.

Stay tuned as we continue to revel more of the story behind the masks and check out Maskmaker for yourself on April 20th.

Sincerely,
The MWM Interactive Team

notes.title: Maskmaker Available April 20th
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,
We hope you are all doing well, and we could not be more excited to announce that Maskmaker will be available for you all to explore on April 20th!

[previewyoutube=b-BFf_49M78;full][/previewyoutube]
From the developers of the award-winning A Fisherman's Tale, Maskmaker is an all-new immersive VR game that takes players to imaginative worlds filled with charismatic and intriguing beings. From mask-to-mask and puzzle-to-puzzle, explore your way through the "mask realm" to seek its apparent ruler, Prospero, and unravel the secret of this identity.   

Mask yourself wisely. Inhabit those you need. Be who you must. This is the power of the Maskmaker.
Available April 20th, 2021.

Sincerely,
The MWM Interactive Team
